title: Nine Tents of Rain
subtitle: 营地与露营 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 营地与露营（生活与学习·户外与旅行）
meta: 主题语境：营地与露营（生活与学习·户外与旅行）　|　核心词汇：camp　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 camp 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 my mother was sent to strike ① a camp she could not find, and she said the finding was the whole of the lesson. The ② camp, meaning the tents and not the walkers, was nine tents wide and was struck by whoever came last; a camp, she said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ camp in that valley had the same fire, and the ④ camp at the edge, meaning the one the leader kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever struck properly. A camp, my grandmother said, is nine parts canvas and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the canvas is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ camp was the whole of the summer, meaning the weeks it held and not the tents. The ⑥ camp, meaning the summer and not any of that, is the only thing in a school that everybody remembers and nobody questions; a camp, he said, is either something you strike or the only word that means both tents and a summer. She said the summer is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ camp had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the fire. The ⑧ camp of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine tents and eleven years of striking; a camp, she said, is either the one at the edge or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ camp I remember is the one at the edge, which was struck in 1973 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ camp, my grandmother said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being struck; every camp, she said, is a summer that has agreed to look like tents. She said the summer was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 营地（指那些帐篷本身，与宿营的人相对）
C. 固定搭配：strike a camp 撤营、拆除营地
D. n. 营地（指山谷里每一处）
E. n. 营地（指边上那一处）
F. n. 营地（抽象：它承载的那几个星期）
G. n. 那个夏天（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a camp she could not find
The camp, meaning the tents and not the walkers
camp was the whole of the summer
the camp had become a photograph in a report
The camp of the whole thing
A camp, my grandmother said in 1977

answers.why: strike a camp 意为“撤营、拆除营地”，1954 年母亲被派去撤一处她找不到的营地。
camp 意为“营地”，指那些帐篷本身而不是宿营的人，共九顶，由最后走的人拆除。
camp 指山谷里每一处营地，每一处都是同样的篝火。
camp 指边上那一处（领队管的一处），是唯一有人认真撤营的。
camp 意为“营地”，抽象指它承载的那几个星期，父亲说 camp 就是那个夏天的全部。
camp 为抽象用法，指那个夏天本身，是学校里人人都记得、却没人质疑的东西。
camp 意为“营地、露营”，到 1968 年这处 camp 成了报告里的一张照片。
camp 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九顶帐篷和十一年的撤营。
camp 意为“营地”，我记得的是边上那一处，1973 年撤掉，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
camp 为抽象总称，祖母说营地是唯一会因为被好好撤掉而变好的东西。
